headline: Hotter PCE Inflation: 5 Defensive ETFs Investors Can Turn to as Rate-Cut Hopes Fade
summary: Hotter-than-expected inflation could keep rates higher. These ETFs offer potentially steadier exposure amid persistent price pressures.

headline: $1000 Invested In Walmart 5 Years Ago Would Be Worth This Much Today
summary: Walmart (NASDAQ:WMT) has outperformed the market over the past 5 years by 5.0% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 16.14%. Currently, Walmart has a market capitalization of $838.78 billion.
